title: Acht
author: Wiebke Scholz
description:
Plot
You have been turned into a spider. Find out what has happened - and survive!

Description
"Acht" is a text-based exploration game set in the 1980s. It is a home-crawler adventure where you control a little spider.

Languages
The game can be played in English or German. The language can be switched in the index.html

Features
While this game is text-based, it has background music to support the atmosphere and make it more immersive. It is recommended to play the game with sound enabled.
